result.title: Learnable Hodge-Laplacian Driven Mixture of Experts for Steady-PDE Surrogates on Coarse Unstructured Meshes
result.summary: Current approaches for steady partial differential equations surrogate models on unstructured meshes apply a single mixing mechanism to the whole solution. This paper proposes an architecture that partitions the solution among vanilla transformer experts, each focused on a different spectral scale. The partition is built from a discrete Hodge Laplacian $L_0=\star_0^{-1} d_0^{\top}\star_1 d_0$, that serves as a fitting layer measuring high-frequency content. A gating mechanism takes the mesh as input and produces the per-vertex weights that recombine the expert outputs. AirFRANS is a steady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) airfoil benchmark. We evaluate our approach in a reduced remeshed version of the benchmark with each unstructured mesh counting 9.6K faces and 4.9K vertices. We compare our approach with the Transolver on the same dataset and dataset slit. Our approach reduces relative $L_2$ error by 31\% and interior mean squared error by 47\%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为粗粒度非结构网格上的稳态 PDE 代理模型提出一种架构：用离散 Hodge Laplacian 作为拟合层度量解的高频含量，将解按谱尺度分配给多个 vanilla transformer 专家，并以网格为输入的 gating 逐顶点生成权重来重组专家输出；在缩小并重网格化的 AirFRANS RANS 翼型基准上对比 Transolver，报告相对 L2 误差降低 31%、内部 MSE 降低 47%。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR/VLM 推理主线无直接关系，但其按谱尺度分解内部表示、再由逐顶点 gating 加权重组的机制，可能可供核查 latent 视觉细节保留与视觉证据筛选/加权这类表示设计问题。
